capture_note: Capture Spec V1 NBA scope: game lines + PTS/REB/AST + common combos, entry and close, from the twice-daily DraftKings capture jobs live since Oct 19, 2026. PRA counts only on slates where combo lines were actually captured (prereg §2): a PRA row without a captured two-sided combo quote is not an entry — at entry the paired-quote admission refuses it, and at close a one-sided combo quote yields CLOSE_SINGLE_SIDED. Frozen boundary (prereg §4): the first countable slate is Wednesday Oct 21, 2026; every capture and game on or before Oct 20, 2026 is historical record, never a prospective entry.
